description: Free: how well prediction-market prices forecast outcomes, per venue. Calibration scorecard for prediction-market venues from resolved markets: the venue's implied probability at fixed horizons before resolution (24h, 7d, 30d) scored against what actually happened — Brier score, base rate, sharpness, and sample counts per venue × category × horizon, with reliability deciles once a cell reaches n ≥ 200. Horizon prices are captured before resolution (never resolution-day prices) and accrue durably. Derived analytics only; free so you can judge market prices before paying for anything built on them. [HTTP: GET /v1/calibration/venues · price free via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/probability.venue-calibration]
